## Checklist

- [ ] `make verify` passes (every example compiles and prints the output shown in the book)
- [ ] New code blocks are tagged correctly (`run`, `check`, `fn`, `error` or `nocheck`)
- [ ] Wording is plain, friendly English with no em dashes
- [ ] The web and PDF editions build (`make web`, `make pdf`) if layout or styles changed
